tools.name: list_open_briefs
tools.description: A few featured public creator briefs (UGC, creator roles, hosting, ambassador), rotated daily, copied from live public postings and verified. Filter by region, category or keyword. Apply on each brief's apply_url, or submit a listing to be matched and introduced instead.

tools.name: preview_match
tools.description: Send a creator or brand profile and get a readiness score, missing fields, and which public briefs fit and why. Stores nothing and never reveals private listings. Use before submitting.

tools.name: submit_creator_listing
tools.description: Create a private, free creator listing for a person who asked you to. The creator must be 18+. lumine emails the creator a one-click confirmation; nothing is matched until they confirm. Returns listing_id and status_token.

tools.name: submit_brand_listing
tools.description: Create a private, free brand listing for a brand that asked you to. lumine emails the brand contact a one-click confirmation; nothing is matched until they confirm. Returns listing_id and status_token.

tools.name: get_listing_status
tools.description: Status of a listing you submitted: pending_confirmation, confirmed, in_review, matched, intro_sent, closed, declined or expired. Needs the status_token from the submit call. Never returns listing details.

tools.name: submit_agency_roster
tools.description: Bulk-list up to 100 creators or brands an agency represents. The agency contact confirms the roster by email first, then every member confirms their own listing. Nobody is matched before their own yes.

tools.name: get_roster_status
tools.description: Counts by status for a roster you submitted. Needs the roster_status_token. Never returns member details.

tools.name: create_prefill_link
tools.description: Build a lumineapp.co/list link with fields filled in, for a person who prefers to review and send the form themselves. Nothing is saved until they press send.

tools.name: get_about
tools.description: What lumine is, how matching and intros work, rules for agents, limits and links.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_agency_roster, create_prefill_link · Private data: preview_match, submit_creator_listing, submit_brand_listing, submit_agency_roster · Public sink: list_open_briefs, preview_match, submit_creator_listing, submit_brand_listing, get_listing_status, submit_agency_roster, create_prefill_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_agency_roster, create_prefill_link · Private data: preview_match, submit_creator_listing, submit_brand_listing, submit_agency_roster · Public sink: list_open_briefs, preview_match, submit_creator_listing, submit_brand_listing, get_listing_status, submit_agency_roster, create_prefill_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
